representations.name: minimal actual centre-leaf identity block
representations.new_information: Retains G,F0,B,R_j,Q_j and all four simultaneous identities for one genuine leaf of the power-large normal form.
representations.first_test: List every multiplicative identity and its five aggregate unit variables without importing the formal matrix.

representations.name: actual-to-formal row comparison map
representations.new_information: Labels source-product, complement-product and quotient-identity rows by their actual polynomials and compares their coefficient vectors to m=1.
representations.first_test: Permute actual columns to (g,f,b,r,q) and demand exact row equality.

representations.name: observable versus identity row typing
representations.new_information: Separates algebraically zero rows from rows whose right sides are absolute units of Fj,F0,PAj,PA0.
representations.first_test: Delete complement observables and recover the source-only spectrum-shift kernel.

representations.name: absolute-spectrum conditioning ledger
representations.new_information: Records whether each product-unit value merely exists in one block or is constant on a power-large common fibre.
representations.first_test: Locate a theorem charging the joint profile of all PAj absolute units.

representations.name: ambient Gamma coordinate tensor
representations.new_information: Treats the torsion-free exponent group Gamma as Z^r and tensors the scalar coefficient matrix coordinatewise.
representations.first_test: Compute kernel and cokernel for symbolic lattice rank r from the primitive scalar matrix.

representations.name: augmentation sign normalization
representations.new_information: Tracks the plus/minus-one unit coordinate separately and tests whether positive nonzero augmentations canonically fix every aggregate factor sign.

representations.name: factor-occurrence refinement matrix
representations.new_information: Expands B into its Omega(B) normalized irreducible occurrences and records which occurrences enter each Rj and Qj.
representations.first_test: Compare the refined kernel with the aggregate rj,qj variables and classify internal associate redistributions.

representations.name: aggregate projection kernel ledger
representations.new_information: Computes which raw occurrence-unit directions vanish after summing to G,F0,B,Rj,Qj.
representations.first_test: Exhibit whether any extra kernel changes an actual product mask or is only normalization gauge.

representations.name: power-large observable-profile fibre
representations.new_information: Counts joint absolute source/complement unit profiles across the selected J rather than assuming all rows fixed for free.
representations.first_test: Test whether the archive gives a t^o(1) profile bound or a retained t^(5/9-o(1)) fibre.

representations.name: realization-to-all-target interface
representations.new_information: Keeps realization logically separate from qU target occurrence mass, distance fibres and outer stability.
representations.first_test: Require named inequalities retaining t^(28/9-o(1)) occurrences and fibre below t^(1/9-epsilon).
